text.card: A red giant 1,390 parsecs away, 16 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.83 solar masses and 15.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,528 K at its surface.
